messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

message.content: The best time to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for, but generally the shoulder seasons—late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October)—offer a great balance of pleasant weather, lower crowds, and more reasonable prices. During these months you’ll enjoy warm temperatures (mid‑70s to low‑80s °F or 24–28 °C), plenty of sunshine, and lower humidity compared to the peak summer season. If you’re after the absolute best weather, late April through early June and September through mid‑October tend to have the most consistent sunny days and comfortable temperatures.
